sources.excerpt: XT-2 Xtortion Published on July 12, 2005 Boss compact pedals distortion pedal schematics Information The Boss XT-2 Xtortion is a high-gain distortion pedal engineered for modern guitarists seeking precise tonal control and aggressive saturation. Designed for rock, metal, grunge, and other high-intensity styles, the XT-2 delivers a tight, punchy distortion with clear articulation and minimal noise. Its EQ section includes dedicated contour and punch controls, enabling players to sculpt a range of tones from scooped and aggressive to mid-forward and cutting. The pedal responds well to both single-coil and humbucking pickups and is optimized for riff-heavy playing, with strong note definition even under heavy gain. Housed in Boss's durable compact enclosure, the XT-2 offers reliable performance for both studio and stage applications. Controls Level: Adjusts the overall output volume Distortion: Sets the amount of gain and saturation Contour: Adjusts the midrange character from scooped to boosted Punch: Adds low-end and upper-mid emphasis for increased presence Specifications Power: 9V PP3 battery or compatible Boss PSA adapter Bypass: Buffered Enclosure: Compact Boss chassis with thumbscrew battery access Indicators: Red LED (effect status) Connectivity: Standard ¼" input and output jacks Power Access: External DC jack (9V), internal battery compartment Highlights High-gain distortion tailored for modern heavy styles Unique EQ section with Contour and Punch for detailed tone shaping Low-noise circuitry, even at high gain levels Maintains clarity and articulation with dense distortion Durable build and tool-free battery access for stage reliability Suitable for soloing, riffing, and rhythm work across varied genres Video Date ▼▲ Maker ▼▲ Video ▼▲ Time ▼▲ 2026-08-23 Leon Todd BOSS XT-2 Xtortion || Great or Garbage? 13:43 2026-07-09 Leon Todd IS the BOSS Xtortion Any Good? #guitar #pinkfloyd #bosspedals #guitartone 1:24 2025-02-16 DomeNightBearer I could not believe how this rare Boss Pedal actually sounds! sources.excerpt: Boss XT-2 Xtortion Distortion - Pedal of the Day Reviews Demos Buy a Pedalboard Interviews Contact Navigation Menu Menu Boss XT-2 Xtortion Distortion Posted By Pedal of the Day on Sunday, March 22, 2020 in Boss, Overdrive / Distortion | 0 comments --> --> When you think of the main innovators in effects pedal history, there’s one name that’s near, if not at, the top of just about everyone’s list: Boss . Crushing the game since before most of you were probably born, these guys just keep churning out hit after hit, and have for decades. Once in a while, however, they release a pedal that folks, for whatever reason, just don’t dig. Those pedals’ production usually gets halted fairly quickly, and they die off into the history books, until years later when they are re-discovered by a new generation. Such is the case with today’s pedal, the XT-2 Xtortion, a ripping distortion pedal that has been described rather unfavorably for many moons, although the players who dig it REALLY dig it. Let’s see what some call “the worst pedal Boss ever made,” shall we? Now, if you’re looking for a plug-and-play distortion , this one might not be for you. The controls are labeled, and work, rather obscurely, and it takes some sitting down with the XT-2 to find the hidden powers it holds inside. Level and Distortion do what they always do, but Contour and Punch are not knobs you often find on ANY pedal. In the XT-2’s case, Contour cuts the highs or boosts the lows, while Punch sets the distortion depth, adding in a bit of mid boost as well. These two parameters work together to create a wide array of distortion sounds, ranging from grunge to hard-edged to solid rhythm and more. Touted as providing a cutting-edge 90’s distortion sound, this one takes a bit of finesse to work into your rig, but once there, you’ll love how it sounds. As with any pedal, the XT-2 Xtortion is not going to be for everyone. In fact, a good majority of you might not like it at all. That said, we thought it was a pretty rad pedal, and after experimenting with some settings, we put together a little demo video (see below) so you can hear it in action. Will this one ever make it into the Boss Hall of Fame, like say the CE-2 or the DC-2? No, no it won’t. But, if you’re on the hunt for a relatively inexpensive distortion, and want to try something that really doesn’t sound like anything else, this is one that will fit the bill precisely. Enjoy! sources.excerpt: XT-2 Xtortion by BOSS | RockBoard | PedalPedia Skip to main content LOG IN EXPLORE BOSS XT-2 Xtortion LOG IN TO SUGGEST IMPROVEMENTS DISTORTION Description Produced between 1996 and 1998, this high-gain distortion unit delivers aggressive, cutting tones tailored for heavy rock, industrial, and metal genres. Instead of conventional passive equalization or dedicated high and low potentiometers, it relies on a specialized active tone-shaping network governed by two distinct midrange filters. The Punch control functions as a pre-distortion boost to add mid-frequency presence, bite, and attack. Meanwhile, the Contour control modifies post-distortion equalization to scoop or reshape midrange bands across its rotation sweep. Internal multi-stage clipping diodes generate dense harmonic saturation while preserving tight low-end response. A standard Level and Distortion configuration allows users to balance master output and saturation levels.
